name: K.K. Moggie
bio: K.K. Moggie is an actress from New Zealand. She holds a MFA in acting from Columbia University.

credits.title: Verity
credits.overview: Lowen Ashleigh, hired to ghostwrite for best-selling author Verity Crawford, uncovers Verity's autobiographical notes, and becomes involved in what may prove to be a lethal conspiracy.

credits.title: After Party
credits.overview: Young, up-and-coming photographer, Lana, begrudgingly attends the party of a pretentious and cool gallery owner in the hopes of meeting a respected dealer who may hold the key to her success. credits.title: You Beautiful Crazy Blind Cripple
credits.overview: A criminal on the run stumbles across the isolated farmhouse of an eccentric blind widow, and her charm, humor, and vulnerability lead to an unlikely romance.

credits.title: Memory Box
credits.overview: A young mother works at a memory-recreation facility. When a client pushes her to break the rules, she's forced to decide how far she's willing to go. Dreams and fantasy become entangled with memory as power shifts hands.

credits.title: The Audition
credits.overview: Robert De Niro and Leonardo DiCaprio must compete for the lead role in Martin Scorsese's next film.

credits.title: Home
credits.overview: The story of a man suffering from mental illness who attempts to rebuild his life.

credits.title: The Sleeping Dictionary
credits.overview: In the 1930s, British officer John Truscott journeys to a remote village in colonial Malaysia to educate and Westernize the local Iban population. credits.title: Anna and the King
credits.overview: The story of the romance between the King of Siam (now Thailand) and the widowed British school teacher Anna Leonowens during the 1860s. Anna teaches the children and becomes romanced by the King. She convinces him that a man can be loved by just one woman.
